description: We are Team NorthStar, a group of university and high school students from Myanmar who come from computer science, data, and design. We share a love of space science and a simple belief: open NASA data should help the people who need it most. That brought us together for this year’s NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our goal with Farm O’Clock is a practical, honest tool that helps smallholder farmers and extension workers choose when to sow and which crop rotation to try.
